x: This team consisted of Doubleday, Ogilvie, Roberts and True, the two first-named taking their first team prizes in Club teams. Our "A" team was placed third; and so we may be considered to have had an excellent Saturday afternoon out.

Our "B" team (Clark, Doubleday, Roberts and True) managed to get in the prize-winners again, taking second handicap team prize. Brunning, Jones and Little also gave us encouraging performances, and their constant support of open races is an excellent testimony to their keenness and club-spirit.

Incidentally, the "Berman" Cup had been allocated, by kind permission of the R.W.A., to our event, and this win—our third in succession—made the trophy the Club's own property. Bill True (10 min. 30 sec. allowance) won the handicap event, with A.
True second and Len Fletcher, making a welcome come-back, gaining third place. With three heats in the 220 Yards, the following qualified for the final, G.
George Beecham won the 2 miles walk handicap with our old friend Harry Shields battling away to gain 2nd place from Bill True, the handicapper!
Maurice Nye took 3rd individual handicap and our "A" Team of Nye, Newson, True and Hall were 2nd handicap Team. Considering the state of the day, the lads walked very well, and what a day!
